The change bounds each classic `mort` subtable with its own reader and interprets contextual entry offsets as signed 16-bit word offsets. For each offset, `_readClassicSubstitutions` computes the glyph range whose complete replacement words lie at or beyond the substitution-table start and within the subtable, then decodes every replacement in that range, for both negative and positive offsets.
